passwordAndAnnouncement.scope: Real v3 password login -> recent-login eligibility -> approved normal admin announcement publication -> v3 notification; no SQL recipient seeding
checks: failed password login does not update activity
real successful password login records current time without online or geo changes
real cookie refresh and authenticated read do not record another login
actual published announcement reaches recently v3-logged-in owner
actual announcement description uses current escaped title
actual announcement hides withdrawn target after prior readable response
actual announcement owner isolation and authentication remain

nativeQR.scope: Real full-application QR create/claim/double-confirm/consume/native refresh flow using independent development account; no APP source or browser grant injection
checks: QR create and claim do not record login
premature consume does not record login
both explicit confirmations leave login time unchanged
actual one-time APP consume records current login time
already-consumed request cannot record another login
actual native refresh and ordinary resource read preserve login time

cleanup.nativeCleanup: First probe used transactional exact family revocation after harness media error; subsequent grants revoked through existing OAuth revoke endpoint; no other grants changed

harnessCorrections: OAuth token/revoke require URL-encoded form, not JSON
Native protocol calls omit browser Origin; no CORS relaxation
OAuth success token response is standard top-level snake_case, not v3 code/data envelope
limits: Complete admin browser UI was not tested; registered admin form handlers were used
Perfect type22 actual notification/reward generation was verified before this run; this run did not repeat the reward to redo its list/detail matrix
No production captcha/blacklist/unlock or full CDN/directory/upload-download audit
Natural read-settlement/profession chain remains independently observed
